papers.title: A causal account of the neural origins of mental fatigue.
papers.reason: Causal DLPFC stimulation and spectroscopy findings directly address cognitive control effort and fatigue mechanisms relevant to executive-function models.

papers.title: Elite basketball athletes at rest: enhanced sensorimotor activity and reduced cognitive load
papers.reason: The paper reports resting-state fMRI differences involving cognitive control and attention networks, but its core focus is athlete sensorimotor expertise rather than executive-function modelling or impairment assessment.

papers.title: The quiet end of the spectrum: A case report and review of "simple schizophrenia".
papers.reason: The title indicates a clinical schizophrenia case review with no provided evidence of executive-function modelling, neuroscience findings, or digital cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Altered brain-state dynamics and associations with dependence severity and affective-somatic burden in cocaine use disorder.
papers.reason: Hidden Markov modelling of resting-state fMRI identifies altered frontoparietal and attention-state dynamics in cocaine use disorder, with clear relevance to neural mechanisms of cognitive control.

papers.title: Modelo dinâmico aplicado ao processamento de informações matemáticas
papers.reason: The paper proposes a nonlinear dynamical model explicitly simulating interactions among attention, working memory, and cognitive effort during mathematical problem solving.

papers.title: The integrated bioenergetic-interoceptive model of schizophrenia-spectrum disorders
papers.reason: The paper presents a broad theoretical model of schizophrenia involving predictive regulation and cognitive control networks, but executive function is only one component of a wider multisystem account.

papers.title: Simulation-based neural dynamics of stress-related negative cognitive bias in depressive symptoms: a dynamical EEG/ERP framework
papers.reason: The study builds a nonlinear state-space model linking cognitive control, arousal, stress-related bias, and EEG/ERP observables, although it is simulation-based rather than empirically validated.

papers.title: VR Scout for AD: An Immersive Virtual Reality System towards Early Screening of Alzheimer's Disease.
papers.reason: The title indicates an immersive VR system for early Alzheimer's screening, making it relevant to digital cognitive assessment despite the lack of methodological detail in the provided summary.

papers.title: Eyes-open resting-state EEG microstate analysis using ratio-normalized parameters across four- and seven-class solutions in healthy controls, mild cognitive impairment, and Alzheimer's disease.
papers.reason: Resting-state EEG microstate analysis across healthy controls, MCI, and Alzheimer's disease is relevant to clinical neurophysiological biomarkers, though not specifically executive-function focused.

papers.title: ВПЛИВ ФІЗИЧНОЇ ТЕРАПІЇ ТА ЕРГОТЕРАПІЇ НА МОТОРНІ ТА СЕНСОРНІ ПОКАЗНИКИ ПАЦІЄНТІВ ПІСЛЯ ІНСУЛЬТУ
papers.reason: The study is primarily about physical and occupational therapy for post-stroke motor recovery, with cognitive outcomes assessed only generally via MoCA.

papers.title: Neural evidence for progressive decline of visual face recognition ability in Alzheimer's disease.
papers.reason: The paper uses EEG to assess face identity recognition deficits across MCI and Alzheimer's disease, making it relevant to clinical cognitive biomarkers but not to executive-function modelling specifically.

papers.title: AI-integrated Approaches in Alzheimer's Disease: Linking Molecular Pathways, Biomarkers, and Emerging Therapies.
papers.reason: The title suggests a broad Alzheimer's biomarker and therapy review using AI, with no clear connection to executive-function modelling or behavioural, eye-tracking, or EEG-based assessment.

papers.title: Effects of Intermittent Theta-Burst Stimulation over the Left Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex on Executive Function During Sustained Simulated Flight Operations: A Randomized Crossover Study Using a Flight–Cognitive Dual-Task Paradigm
papers.reason: This directly tests DLPFC stimulation effects on human working memory updating and rule switching with EEG microstate and fNIRS measures, making it highly relevant to neural and behavioural mechanisms of executive function.

papers.title: Working Memory Disruption and Altered Alpha Dynamics in Misophonics
papers.reason: This reports behavioural and EEG alpha-band evidence for altered auditory working memory and distractor inhibition in a clinical-relevant human group, directly informing models of attention and working memory control.

papers.title: Projection Neurons from Infralimbic (IL) to the Basolateral Amygdala (BLA) are Critical for the Expression of Social Familiarity induced Anxiolysis (SoFiA) in rats
papers.reason: This animal study identifies a prefrontal-amygdala pathway for social safety learning and anxiety regulation, but its link to planning, working memory, attention, or executive-function modelling is indirect.
